summary: Tested the notification module end to end: backend (14 pytest, all PASS) and UI (admin, student and counsellor, at desktop and 390px). BACKEND: GET /api/admin/notifications returns 7 events in order and the providers (email connected=false, sms mode=demo). Non-admin users (student and counsellor) get 403 on list, log, PUT and test. PUT returns 404 for an unknown id and 400 for an empty body, and a toggle persists. 'Send test to me' gives email not_connected, sms demo, app sent. With SMS off, SMS logs 'off'. Log filters event and channel work, and _id and key are not in the response. Contacts: GET/PUT /me/contact rejects a bad email or phone with 422. Clearing the email makes email log no_contact. Booking hooks: Meera booking a slot logs 6 session_booked rows (Meera + Kavya x 3 channels) and both inboxes get it. Her cancel logs 6 session_cancelled rows, with SMS as 'demo' to her phone. A Meera request (pending) notifies both. Kavya confirming it with a slot fires session_booked. Kavya cancelling fires session_cancelled ('Dr. Kavya Menon cancelled…') and frees the slot. Cron: both endpoints return 401 without auth and 200 in under 5s with auth. A duplicate X-Webhook-Id returns duplicate:true. The sweep does not duplicate week1/week2 (each key has exactly 3 rows). Session reminder: a temporary slot + booking 40 min ahead created 6 remind rows and did not duplicate on a second sweep; the temporary data was then removed. Low-mood: PATCH with Meera's unchanged moods sent low_mood_alert to Kavya (3 rows), deduped on a second PATCH, and her moods are unchanged. /cron/reminders created checkin_reminder rows for Ananya and Meera (Rohan's plan is complete, so he has no pending check-in). UI: the admin Notifications tab shows the 3 provider cards, 7 rows and 21 switches. A switch persists after reload. The test toast shows per-channel status (incl. 'SMS: Turned off'), the log shows 3 rows, the filters work, and the bell inbox lists the [Test] items, with the badge cleared on close. Student (Meera): profile menu > Contact details is prefilled. Invalid email and invalid phone show error toasts, and a valid save closes the dialog. Booking a slot shows a toast and a 'Counselling session booked' item in the bell. Cancel shows 'You cancelled…'. The 'Day 6 check-in is waiting' shortcut opens the Daily activity log dialog. Counsellor: the bell shows session booked/cancelled and the low-mood alert, with no pending shortcut. The header contact icon is prefilled. Regressions: the admin Games tab loads, and student home, counsellor and admin have no horizontal scroll at 390px. TWO UI BUGS FOUND AT 390px (see frontend_issues).

ui_bugs.issue: The header overflows: document scrollWidth is 437px against a 390px viewport. The Sign out button (logout-button) sits at x=395-437, off-screen, and the page scrolls sideways. The cause is that the theme toggle, the report download button (children), the bell, the contact icon and sign out all fit on admin/counsellor pages but not with the extra download button. Fix: use gap-1 on mobile and reduce the button sizes, hide the theme toggle under sm, or move contact/sign out into a dropdown like the student HomeLayout.

The 3 channel chips (Email/SMS/App) are 373px wide in a 356px row. The App switch is clipped by the card's overflow-hidden, so the App toggle is partly hidden and hard to tap on mobile. The 'when' text is also cut off at the right edge. Fix: add flex-wrap to the chips container ('flex flex-wrap gap-2') and/or min-w-0 on the grid row.

issues: The booking card ('Talk to a counsellor', book-session-btn) is on the Home and My Journey tabs, not on the Support tab ('Who Can Help & When to Ask'). Users who open Support to book a counsellor will not find the button there. Consider adding the CounsellorCard to Support.
Cancelling a booking happens on one click with no confirmation.

action_items: Fix the AppHeader overflow at 390px on ReportView (sign out is off-screen and the page scrolls sideways).
Make the notification channel chips wrap on mobile in NotificationsManager (the App switch is clipped).
critical_code_review_comments: push_notify.run_reminders: `db.notifications.find_one({'key': key})` never matches, because notify.send stores notifications with key '<batch>:app' = 'checkin:<uid>:<date>:<slot>:app'. Dedup still works through the notification_log key check in send(), so this is dead code. Remove it or fix the key.

notify.send writes log rows with the idempotency key even when every channel is 'off'. If the admin has week1/week2 or a session_reminder switched off when the sweep runs, turning it back on later will never deliver that notice (the key already exists). Consider skipping the key or the log when all channels are off.

notify.send idempotency is check-then-insert with no unique index on notification_log.key/channel. Two concurrent sweeps with different run ids could double-send. Consider a unique index on (key, channel) where key is not null.
counselling.update_booking does not check that b.counsellor_id == user.id, so any counsellor can cancel or confirm any booking. This only matters with more than one counsellor.
admin_list last_sent counts test sends and not_connected/no_contact rows as 'sent'. That is fine for a demo but may mislead admins.
seed_data_creation: No assessments taken. Created and then cancelled 3 Meera bookings (2 slot bookings, 1 request, all now cancelled; slots freed). Temporary TEST_ slot and booking for the session reminder were deleted along with their log and notification rows. Test sends and booking notifications remain in notification_log and the inboxes. All 21 switches are ON (verified in the DB). All 5 contacts match the original values (verified). Meera's moods are unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py -n 0`. It uses pymongo directly to check notification_log by key (keys are excluded from the API). The student CounsellorCard (book-session-btn, slot-<id>, cancel-booking-<id>) is on the Home tab. On login, students get a daily check-in popup; click 'Remind me later' first. The slot locator is '[data-testid^="slot-"]:not([data-testid="slot-picked"])'.
